docs.DeferCall: is a command used to call up a function after a programmed delay.
docs.MapKeyIOUMD: allows you to generate up to 6 different outputs on a single button (although in doing so, it obviously becomes more difficult to remember all the outputs!).
docs.MapKeyR: works exactly like MapKey, except that the function is activated when the controller button turns "OFF".
docs.CHAIN: is the command that gives you the ability to have multiple outputs by pressing a button once.
docs.TEMPO: gives the pilot the possibility of having 2 functions on a single button.
docs.REXEC: is a function built to repeat an EXEC until you want to stop by releasing the button or sending the order to stop.
docs.SetSCurve: is the function used to fine-tune your Joystick axis and rudder axes response.
docs.SetJCurve: is dedicated to adjusting the sensitivity of the axes used to control a throttle, mixture, propeller pitch and brakes.
docs.SetCustomCurve: gives you the opportunity to do exactly what you want.
docs.LockAxis: is a Function that "freezes" the value of a particular axis.
docs.AXMAP1: is the first one. In mode 1, it is the "direction" of the axis that defines the output event (keystrokes, for example).
docs.AXMAP2: is the second Digital axis mode. AXMAP2 generates functions that only depend on the zone.
